## Houston 0.6.14

### Publish agents straight from Settings

- **Copy an agent and publish it to the Agent Store, right from Settings** — now the default tab when you open an agent, so sharing what you built takes one click.

### New integration: Croma

- **Croma joins the curated integrations list**, discoverable by your agents for Colombian public data (traffic cameras, procurement records, company filings).

### Fixes and polish

- **Clearer status while things wake up.** Renaming an agent, logging into a provider, or reconnecting after a pause now shows a calm "waking up" notice instead of looking broken.
- **Local AI connections report their real state.** A disconnected tunnel to your own computer's AI model no longer shows as still connected.
- **Usage and provider error messages are easier to read** and stay visible instead of scrolling out of view.
- Additional reliability improvements under the hood.
